news.headline: SanDisk Shares Decline Following Kioxia Pricing Warning
news.summary: SanDisk stock experienced downward pressure on November 15, 2026, following a pricing warning issued by Kioxia.

news.headline: Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix Fail to Dismiss DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit
news.summary: A court has denied a motion by Micron Technology, Samsung, and SK Hynix to dismiss a lawsuit alleging price-fixing in the DRAM market.

news.summary: Ryan Detrick calls the 17% SOXX rebound a historic 'buying thrust,' signaling that the chip stock massacre has flushed out everybody.

news.headline: AMD Stock Is Falling Monday: What's Going On?
news.summary: AMD stock tumbles as investors dump tech shares, while experts highlight opportunities to challenge NVIDIA's AI dominance.

news.headline: NVIDIA Must Now Prove It's Bigger Than Jensen Huang
news.summary: NVIDIA stock slips ahead of Q3 FY27 earnings as Wall Street weighs Jensen Huang’s exit, export risks, and rising AI competition.

news.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Controversy Could Backfire on China, Chamath Palihapitiya Says — Washington May Get the Chip Controls It's Been Seeking
